Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Fri, 11 Feb 2000 16:24:34 GMT, tmpi...@unity.ncsu.edu wrote:

>I'm sure these have been asked before, but I'm not terribly smart and
>need to be reminded of such trivial things.
>
>1. I control 2 vampires and one is a prince. This prince attempts
>calls a vote that requires a prince to call. This action is blocked
>and my other vamp, who is not a prince, plays mask of 1,000
>faces....what happens?

Can't Mask an action that you couldn't have begun in the first place.
So you can't "Just kidding, it was actually... Thetmes!" when someone
intercepts Rake, since Thetmes is a prince and couldn't have been
doing it originally.

-- Derek

Subject: Rules Team Rulings - 23 June 1998
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 1998 11:01:50 -0700
Message-ID: <358FED...@wizards.com>

Mask of a Thousand Faces:
Cannot be used to mask an action if the Masking vampire is not capable of
taking that action, nor if any action modifiers have been played on this
action that could not have been played if the Masking vampire were the
acting minion.
